identitySignals: Name matches exactly: the UC Berkeley Destination College Advising Corps (DCAC) website, run by UC Berkeley's Center for Educational Partnerships
The DCAC school-partners page lists Castlemont High School (Oakland), matching the agenda item about Castlemont High School
DCAC places College Adviser Fellows in schools, matching OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' category and the Measures N and H College and Career Readiness context
research.notes: This is a program of UC Berkeley (The Regents of the University of California), not a separate nonprofit; no ProPublica listing exists under this name. Legal name, EIN, CA entity number and UEI left null for that reason. Other UC campuses/chapters use similar names, but the Castlemont High School listing ties the Berkeley chapter to Oakland.

profile.address: Destination College Advising Corps, University of California, Berkeley, 1 Hearst Field Annex, Building C50, Berkeley, CA 94720-1060
profile.summary: Destination College Advising Corps is a University of California, Berkeley program that places recent college graduates in high schools as full-time College Adviser Fellows. The advisers help low-income, first-generation and underrepresented students prepare for and apply to college. It operates under UC Berkeley's Center for Educational Partnerships.
